inputs.tags: Upbeat contemporary pop track with a bright major key feel and steady four-on-the-floor pulse. Crisp drum machine and bouncy synth bass drive the groove, while shimmering electric guitars add rhythmic texture. A clear male vocalist delivers an energetic, smiling performance with tight, harmonized backing vocals that emphasize unity and happiness. The arrangement builds through layered hooks and a catchy, repetitive chorus that feels celebratory and warm.
inputs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(Synths swell, drums kick in)

[Verse 1 - Male Singer]
Sunlight hits the pavement today
We’re walking fast, we’re finding our way
No worries here, just you and me
Laughing loud at the melody

[Chorus - Male Singer]
Oh, it’s friendship, it’s joy
Every moment is a voice
Side by side, we shine
on to this delight
Yeah, it’s friendship, it’s joy
(Woah-oh-oh)

Shadows fade when you’re around
Best friends that I’ve ever found
Simple things make hearts grow strong

(Woah-oh-oh)
